claims.statement: The exact 121 grouped-factor finite-ULC checks, the stated cutoff scalar, and the path-plus-private-star graph-to-leaf polynomial identities on profiles (2) and (2,3) are supported; the full infinite-family aggregate conclusion remains unestablished by this review.
claims.scope: Narrowed evidence only: exact factor pairs F_r B_s for 2<=r,s<=12; the scalar cutoff at D=12,h=17,m=100000000; and full subset enumeration for the two explicitly listed small profiles. No arbitrary-tree or full all-profile theorem conclusion.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: The arithmetic replay passes, and independent finite subset enumeration supports the graph and distinct-tag formulas on the stated small profiles. The full theorem depends on all-profile coefficientwise mixed-minor envelopes, shifted-index bounds, and uniform selector transfer that this review did not completely rederive. This is an explicit review limitation, not a mathematical counterexample or a finding that those steps are false.

limitations: The infinite-family mixed-minor perturbation envelopes and all shifted-index endpoint conditions were not completely rederived independently.
The graph formulas were independently checked by subset enumeration only for profiles (2) and (2,3), far below the assigned m cutoff.
The cutoff arithmetic replay does not establish the full uniform all-profile coefficient and selector argument.
No arbitrary-tree or below-cutoff conclusion is supported.
